description: This source file defines the ASP.NET Core MVC controller 'ArticlesController' responsible for handling HTTP requests related to articles, such as retrieving lists, getting details, creating, editing, and deleting articles within the 'Conduit' web application.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller handling article-related endpoints, utilizing MediatR to delegate business logic.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a list of articles, possibly filtered by tag, author, favorited status, with pagination options.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the user's personalized article feed, with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch detailed information about a specific article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authentication.

methods.name: Edit

methods.name: Delete
